observations: The selected archetype remained a flat colored polygon before Generate to 3D.
Generate to 3D persisted the exact Batch 20 family, variant, appearance kit, planting structure and metric target.
The compiled globe showed repeatable whole trestle modules, a shade-tree grid, a small bounded kiosk, overhead strings and the exact reference-derived surface.
An initial live render exposed two tent-like ground triangles caused by incompatible Google-tile vertex samples beside the building.
The repaired workflow uses one robust level construction datum for the compiled park and seats its LEGO kit on that same datum; the source tiles no longer protrude or pull the park surface upward.
The separately compiled building remained independent from the park family throughout the trial.
